features: SLIDE INTO THE RETRO VIBE — Bring back the charm of classic digicams with a distinctive sliding camera design made to stand out. Slide it open, frame your shot and capture the moment with a compact camera that combines nostalgic point-and-shoot styling with convenient modern features. Perfect for travel, college, parties and everyday photography.

64MP PHOTOS + 4K VIDEO RECORDING — Capture everyday memories, portraits, travel moments and creative shots with photos up to 64MP, or switch to 4K (3840 × 2160) video recording for detailed clips, casual vlogs and memorable moments with friends and family.

AUTO FOCUS FOR QUICK & EASY POINT-AND-SHOOT PHOTOGRAPHY — Spend less time adjusting your camera and more time enjoying the moment. Auto Focus helps make everyday shooting simple and convenient, whether you're capturing portraits, street scenes, travel memories or spontaneous snapshots. An approachable choice for beginners, students and casual photographers.

16X DIGITAL ZOOM + 2.8-INCH IPS SCREEN — Use the 16X Digital Zoom to bring distant subjects closer, while the large 2.8-inch IPS display makes it convenient to compose your shots, navigate camera functions and review captured photos and videos directly on the camera.

COMPACT RETRO CAMERA MADE FOR CREATORS — Blending a vintage-inspired aesthetic with a portable body, this compact digicam is made for travel photography, college life, parties, everyday snapshots and casual vlogging. A fun choice for beginners, students, teens and anyone rediscovering the charm of retro digital photography.

TYPE-C CONNECTIVITY + UP TO 128GB TF CARD SUPPORT — Keep your everyday shooting setup convenient with USB Type-C connectivity, self-timer functionality and TF memory card support up to 128GB. The camera also includes a battery, lanyard, carrying bag and cable, giving you the essential accessories for shooting, carrying and using your camera on the go.
